comment: M10 golden-slice art review. Eye-height spectator views of every beat on the authored route through the Common Carrier's three decks: passenger deck, forward cargo, lower service, the freight shaft, the aft hold, the command approach and its window. Run with FRAGR_QA_BOTS=0 FRAGR_QA_MAP_FILE=server/maps/m10_common_carrier.json. Look at each still against docs/design/space.md, the art bible and the Recall Notice bar; this is art review, not combat or fresh-player evidence. Boarders appear in m10-golden-guards.json and through combat in client/qa/m10_common_carrier.json.

states.name: passenger_arrival
states.note: Arrival on the passenger deck, looking aft down the middle deck toward the freight shaft rails.

states.name: passenger_berths
states.note: The crew berths: personal blankets, belongings, a small lamp.

states.name: passenger_port
states.note: The port side of the passenger deck by the west stair trunk: rescued people's bedding and bags.

states.name: repair_bench
states.note: The body repair bench.

states.name: galley
states.note: The galley island and the queue.

states.name: passenger_aft
states.note: The aft end of the passenger deck.

states.name: west_stair
states.note: Inside the west stair trunk between the lower and middle decks.

states.name: forward_cargo
states.note: The forward cargo hold on the lower deck: lashed cargo, a handling path, the shaft ahead.

states.name: forward_racks
states.note: The lashed cargo and the two-level cargo face where the first boarders come through.

states.name: cargo_stock
states.note: The cargo stock lockers by the forward bulkhead.

states.name: lower_service
states.note: The lower service deck: coolant machinery, pipes, work light.

states.name: power_bank
states.note: The power bank at fighting distance.

states.name: shaft_up
states.note: The freight shaft from the lower deck, looking up through all three decks.

states.name: aft_hold
states.note: The aft hold and the second boarding point.

states.name: east_stair
states.note: The east stair trunk from the lower deck.

states.name: command_approach
states.note: The upper command approach and the long window: black space in a readable frame.

states.name: command_console
states.note: The pilot consoles under the window.

states.name: crew_cubby
states.note: The crew cubby by the west trunk on the upper deck.

states.name: upper_overlook
states.note: The upper overlook above the shaft: the drop to the lower deck.

states.name: aft_gallery
states.note: The aft gallery on the upper deck.

states.name: shaft_down
states.note: Down the freight shaft from the upper deck: three decks, one hull.

states.name: ship_long
states.note: The whole ship forward from the aft gallery to the window.
